description: This file defines an abstract base class 'Renderer' for rendering various document objects in the MigraDoc library, including methods for rendering, formatting, and creating specific renderer instances based on object type.

classes.name: Renderer
classes.description: Abstract base class for all renderers, providing common rendering and formatting functionalities for document objects.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Abstract method to draw the object to the graphics context.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Abstract method to calculate layout and line breaks within a specified area.
